product.name: Zoios Leadership Copilot
product.description: A platform that provides data-driven insights and recommendations to help leaders understand and improve team well-being and performance.

product.name: People Reports
product.description: A tool to convert employee data into customizable analytics, reports, and presentations for organizational insights.

product.name: Workplace Assessment
product.description: A survey tool to design and deploy custom employee surveys for gathering feedback and insights on workplace conditions.

product.name: Feedback Module
product.description: A system to facilitate structured 360° feedback and performance reviews to support employee development.

product.name: Goal Setting and Tracking
product.description: A feature to set, align, and monitor employee goals and development plans in a centralized platform.

product.name: Burnout Prediction and Prevention
product.description: A capability to identify early signs of employee burnout and turnover risk using real-time data analytics.
